description: Check the pre-construction brief(s) of this project, docs/briefs/<area>.brief.yaml, against the brief schema (ADR-106) and say whether each is ready for authoring. Reads only the brief files, the project's pom.xml (and the app BOM poms it inherits from, read from the local Maven repository), the brief schema and, when present, target/classes/exeris-metadata; writes nothing, starts no process and uses no network, and is local only: the family needs the project root, so private product intent never reaches a hosted endpoint. The schema is the one inside the project's pinned eu.exeris:exeris-sdk-source-model jar in the local Maven repository (never downloaded), else the schema bundled with this bridge; `skew.schemaSource` says which. A project pinned below SDK 0.13.0 has no brief contract and gets a reason instead. A brief whose briefSchema is newer than the SDK of the schema used is returned valid:false, ready:false with the skew reported, and is not validated. `valid` means the schema passes. `ready` means valid and no blocking open question is still 'open'; an absent, empty or invalid brief is never ready. `assumed` lists the questions decided on credit with their owner. EARS criteria are checked by structure, never by text. Where the project has been built, each fulfilledBy reference is resolved against the emitted DomainMetadata (an entity by qualified class name; an action, rule or saga as <entity>#<member>); `unresolved` names those that match nothing and does not change readiness, and without metadata every reference is `unchecked`. Optional `area` names one brief; without it every brief directly under docs/briefs is validated, up to 50.

area.description: Optional name of one bounded area (lowercase letters, digits and hyphens): validates docs/briefs/<area>.brief.yaml. A name, never a path.

name: build-validate_brief
